e1.get_wire_connector(edge[3], true) end); local ok2,wc2=pcall(function() return e2.get_wire_connector(edge[6], true) end); if ok1 and ok2 and wc1 and wc2 then wc1.connect_to(wc2, false, defines.wire_origin.script) created=created+1 end else missing=missing+1 end end; game.print("wire repair batch 1/6: created="..created..", missing_entities="..missing.."/"..#edges)
